audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[N].side read "Skill" while content win[0..6] and the packet levelChart both read Orianna, Orianna, Skill, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia, Orianna. Six of the seven rows rendered two different answers.
audit.why: Levels 1-2 are Orianna's on autos and her stacking passive while Cassiopeia is paying 50-70 mana per Noxious Blast. From 4 onward Twin Fang recasts every 0.75s off her own poison and Miasma (24s down to 16s) holds you in its 700 range. At 2+ items grouped play returns to Command: Shockwave, which lands in one command while her damage has to ramp.
audit.corrected: phases sides aligned to the content/packet chart, with phases[3].why, phases[4].why and phases[5].why rewritten to describe Cassiopeia winning those stages.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes carried an unsourced magnitude ("Luden's makes Q-W a third of a health bar") and named no Cassiopeia spike.
audit.why: Her spike curve is Miasma dropping 24s to 16s across ranks and Petrifying Gaze at 120/100/80 — the kit gives no damage fractions.
audit.corrected: Spike line rebuilt on Miasma's rank-5 16s and the level 6 ult trade.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole page is built on Miasma's grounding — focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t all warn that it disables your dashes and leaps.
audit.why: Orianna's kit contains no Movement ability. Q, W and E are all commands to the Ball and R is a shockwave at the Ball; nothing in her kit moves her. The grounding component of Miasma therefore takes nothing from her — the part that actually decides the trade is the slow, which pins her inside Twin Fang's 700 range while it recasts every 0.75s.
audit.corrected: Miasma reframed as a slow that holds you in Twin Fang range, not as a dash-denial.
sources: champ-data/_kits/orianna.json (no dash flag on any slot)

audit.whatIsWrong: content.early and whys[0] both claim Command: Attack out-ranges Noxious Blast.
audit.why: Noxious Blast is 850 range; Command: Attack is 815. She out-ranges Orianna, not the other way round. Level 1-2 is still Orianna's, but on autos, passive stacks and Cassiopeia's mana cost — not on range.
audit.corrected: Both fields rewritten to give the real reason those levels are yours.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was mentioned once, vaguely, as "anti-heal early into his sustain" — and with the wrong pronoun.
audit.why: Twin Fang heals Cassiopeia for a percentage of the damage dealt and recasts every 0.75s, so Grievous Wounds timing decides every extended trade. This is the interaction flagged in _missing for this matchup.
audit.corrected: Named the source of the healing so the reader knows what the anti-heal is for.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cassiopeia is referred to as he/his/him across roughly a dozen fields — tldr, tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.trading, four phases whys, dosFull[0].t, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[1].d, report[0].t, report[3].t, report[8].t and report[9].t.
audit.why: champ-data/champ-gender.js marks cassiopeia female. The templates were written for a male enemy and only the name was swapped.
audit.corrected: Every third-person pronoun referring to Cassiopeia changed to she/her.

notes: Headline finding for this matchup, and probably for the whole champion: Orianna has no Movement ability in her kit, so Miasma's grounding takes nothing from her. Four fields (focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t) were built around dash-denial that cannot apply. Rewrote three of them around the slow, which is the part that actually matters. focus.text is 17 characters so the applier skips it anyway; if the user wants the focus retargeted from Miasma to Twin Fang that is a content decision, not a mechanical one. Second correction: Noxious Blast is 850 range against Command: Attack's 815 — she out-ranges you, and two fields claimed the opposite. Pronouns: cassiopeia is female and roughly a dozen fields called her he/his/him; all fixed. Anti-heal (the _missing flag for this matchup) is now tied to Twin Fang's heal by name.
